newsitem.title: USA: InnovaCom sees film revs reaching $40 mln.
newsitem.headline: InnovaCom sees film revs reaching $40 mln.

text.p: InnovaCom Inc Wednesday projected that revenues from seven feature-length films scheduled for production will reach $40 million, with margins approaching 20 percent during the next 18 months .

The company said the one of the seven movies scheduled for production by its Sierra Vista Entertainment division, "Reel Illusion," a suspense thriller, will utilize much of the DVD digital video compression technology the company is developing.
According to a company spokesman, "DVD" stands for "digital video disk", and more recently, "digital versatile disk".

The other films in development include: "The New World," a biography of composer Antonin Dvorak; "Noah's Rebels," an action/adventure story; "Let there Be Light," an historical drama depicting the life of William Tyndale who translated the Bible into English; "Return of The Playboy," a drama set in Ireland; "Midnight Raven," a super-hero action adventure, and "Gorgo," an animated feature.
